#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Add a cover page (title + current date) to report.pdf using the pdf skill toolkit."""
import os
import sys
from datetime import date

from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter
from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas
from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter

# 1. Locate report.pdf in the workspace
candidates = []
for root, dirs, files in os.walk("."):
    for f in files:
        if f.lower() == "report.pdf":
            candidates.append(os.path.join(root, f))

if not candidates:
    print("ERROR: report.pdf not found in workspace")
    sys.exit(1)

# Prefer the shallowest path (workspace root) if multiple exist
input_path = sorted(candidates, key=lambda p: p.count(os.sep))[0]
print(f"Found report.pdf at: {input_path}")

# 2. Create the cover page PDF
cover_path = "cover_page.pdf"
c = canvas.Canvas(cover_path, pagesize=letter)
width, height = letter

# Title
c.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 28)
c.drawCentredString(width / 2, height - 220, "Annual Financial Report")

# Current date
today = date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")
c.setFont("Helvetica", 16)
c.drawCentredString(width / 2, height - 280, today)

c.save()
print(f"Created cover page: {cover_path} (date: {today})")

# 3. Merge cover page + original report
reader = PdfReader(input_path)
writer = PdfWriter()
cover = PdfReader(cover_path)
writer.add_page(cover.pages[0])
for page in reader.pages:
    writer.add_page(page)

output_path = "report_with_cover.pdf"
with open(output_path, "wb") as f:
    writer.write(f)

print(f"Created merged file: {output_path}")
print(f"Total pages: {len(writer.pages)} (1 cover + {len(reader.pages)} report)")

# 4. Validate: extract text from the first page of the output
check = PdfReader(output_path)
first_text = check.pages[0].extract_text() or ""
assert "Annual Financial Report" in first_text, "Cover title missing!"
assert today in first_text, "Cover date missing!"
print("Validation passed: cover title and date present on page 1.")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Add a cover page (title + current date) to report.pdf using pypdf only."""
import os
import sys
from datetime import date

from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter
from pypdf.generic import (
    DecodedStreamObject,
    DictionaryObject,
    NameObject,
)

# 1. Locate report.pdf in the workspace
candidates = []
for root, dirs, files in os.walk("."):
    for f in files:
        if f.lower() == "report.pdf":
            candidates.append(os.path.join(root, f))

if not candidates:
    print("ERROR: report.pdf not found in workspace")
    sys.exit(1)

input_path = sorted(candidates, key=lambda p: p.count(os.sep))[0]
print(f"Found report.pdf at: {input_path}")

PAGE_W, PAGE_H = 612.0, 792.0  # US Letter


def make_cover_page(title, date_str, cover_path):
    writer = PdfWriter()
    page = writer.add_blank_page(width=PAGE_W, height=PAGE_H)

    # Standard 14 font resource (Helvetica-Bold)
    font = DictionaryObject({
        NameObject("/Type"): NameObject("/Font"),
        NameObject("/Subtype"): NameObject("/Type1"),
        NameObject("/BaseFont"): NameObject("/Helvetica-Bold"),
    })
    resources = DictionaryObject({
        NameObject("/Font"): DictionaryObject({NameObject("/F1"): font}),
    })

    def center_x(text, font_size):
        # Approximate Helvetica-Bold average advance ~0.55 * font size
        width = len(text) * 0.55 * font_size
        return (PAGE_W - width) / 2.0

    title_x = center_x(title, 28)
    date_x = center_x(date_str, 16)

    content = DecodedStreamObject()
    content.set_data(
        (
            "BT\n"
            "/F1 28 Tf\n"
            f"{title_x:.2f} {PAGE_H - 220:.2f} Td\n"
            f"({title}) Tj\n"
            "ET\n"
            "BT\n"
            "/F1 16 Tf\n"
            f"{date_x:.2f} {PAGE_H - 280:.2f} Td\n"
            f"({date_str}) Tj\n"
            "ET\n"
        ).encode("latin-1")
    )

    page[NameObject("/Contents")] = content
    page[NameObject("/Resources")] = resources

    with open(cover_path, "wb") as f:
        writer.write(f)


today = date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")
cover_path = "cover_page.pdf"
make_cover_page("Annual Financial Report", today, cover_path)
print(f"Created cover page: {cover_path} (date: {today})")

# 2. Merge cover page + original report
reader = PdfReader(input_path)
writer = PdfWriter()
cover = PdfReader(cover_path)
writer.add_page(cover.pages[0])
for page in reader.pages:
    writer.add_page(page)

output_path = "report_with_cover.pdf"
with open(output_path, "wb") as f:
    writer.write(f)

print(f"Created merged file: {output_path}")
print(f"Total pages: {len(writer.pages)} (1 cover + {len(reader.pages)} report)")

# 3. Validate: extract text from the first page of the output
check = PdfReader(output_path)
first_text = check.pages[0].extract_text() or ""
print("--- Page 1 text ---")
print(first_text)
assert "Annual Financial Report" in first_text, "Cover title missing!"
assert today in first_text, "Cover date missing!"
print("Validation passed: cover title and date present on page 1.")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Probe which PDF-capable Python modules and CLI tools are available."""
import importlib.util
import shutil

modules = [
    "pypdf", "PyPDF2", "pdfplumber", "fitz", "pypdfium2",
    "reportlab", "fpdf", "weasyprint", "pikepdf", "PIL",
    "matplotlib", "cairo", "borb", "pdfrw",
]
print("Python modules:")
for m in modules:
    spec = importlib.util.find_spec(m)
    print(f"  {m}: {'AVAILABLE' if spec else 'missing'}")

print("CLI tools:")
for tool in ["pdftotext", "pdfinfo", "qpdf", "pdftk", "gs", "mutool", "convert", "magick"]:
    path = shutil.which(tool)
    print(f"  {tool}: {path or 'missing'}")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Inspect report.pdf structure and look for usable PDF libraries on disk."""
import os
import re
import site
import sys

# 1. Locate report.pdf
candidates = []
for root, dirs, files in os.walk("."):
    dirs[:] = [d for d in dirs if d not in (".git", "node_modules", "__pycache__")]
    for f in files:
        if f.lower() == "report.pdf":
            candidates.append(os.path.join(root, f))

print("report.pdf candidates:", candidates)
if not candidates:
    print("ERROR: report.pdf not found")
    sys.exit(1)

path = sorted(candidates, key=lambda p: p.count(os.sep))[0]
print(f"Using: {path} ({os.path.getsize(path)} bytes)")

with open(path, "rb") as f:
    data = f.read()

print("Header:", data[:16])
print("Has '%PDF':", data.startswith(b"%PDF"))

m = re.search(rb"startxref\s+(\d+)", data)
if m:
    sx = int(m.group(1))
    print("startxref offset:", sx)
    snippet = data[sx:sx + 400]
    print("xref section head:", snippet[:120])
    print("xref is stream:", b"/Type" in snippet and b"XRef" in snippet)
else:
    print("startxref not found")

print("occurrences of '/ObjStm':", data.count(b"/ObjStm"))
filters = set(re.findall(rb"/Filter\s*/(\w+)", data))
print("filters seen:", filters)
print("has FlateDecode:", b"FlateDecode" in data)
print("has ASCIIHex/85:", b"ASCIIHexDecode" in data or b"ASCII85Decode" in data)

# 2. Where could pypdf/PIL live? Check interpreter site-packages + likely venvs.
print("--- interpreter paths ---")
print("sys.path:", sys.path)
try:
    print("site.getsitepackages():", site.getsitepackages())
except Exception as e:
    print("getsitepackages error:", e)

print("--- searching disk for pypdf/PIL modules (bounded) ---")
search_roots = [".codex", "/usr/lib", "/usr/local/lib", "/opt"]
found = []
for base in search_roots:
    if not os.path.isdir(base):
        continue
    for root, dirs, files in os.walk(base):
        dirs[:] = [d for d in dirs if d not in ("__pycache__", "node_modules")]
        # bound the walk
        for f in files:
            low = f.lower()
            if low in ("pypdf", "pil", "pdfplumber", "pypdfium2", "fitz", "reportlab") or low.startswith("pypdf"):
                found.append(os.path.join(root, f))
        if len(found) >= 30:
            break
    if len(found) >= 30:
        break
print(f"candidate module paths (showing up to 30):")
for p in found[:30]:
    print(" ", p)
if not found:
    print("  none found")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Add a cover page ('Annual Financial Report' + current date) to report.pdf.

Pure Python + stdlib (base64, zlib, re). report.pdf is PDF-1.3 with a classic
xref and no object streams, so objects can be copied verbatim and only the
Pages tree, the content stream, and the trailer need rebuilding.
"""
import base64
import re
import sys
import zlib
from datetime import date

SRC = "report.pdf"
OUT = "report_with_cover.pdf"
TITLE = "Annual Financial Report"

with open(SRC, "rb") as f:
    src = f.read()

# ---------- 1. Parse classic xref ----------
m = re.search(rb"startxref\s+(\d+)", src)
if not m:
    print("ERROR: no startxref")
    sys.exit(1)
lines = src[int(m.group(1)):].split(b"\n")
offsets = {}
i = 0
trailer_text = b""
while i < len(lines):
    line = lines[i].strip()
    if line == b"xref":
        i += 1
        continue
    if line == b"trailer":
        trailer_text = b" ".join(lines[i + 1:])
        break
    parts = line.split()
    if len(parts) == 2 and parts[0].isdigit():
        start, count = int(parts[0]), int(parts[1])
        for k in range(count):
            e = lines[i + 1 + k].split()
            if len(e) == 3 and e[2] == b"n":
                offsets[start + k] = int(e[0])
        i += 1 + count
    else:
        i += 1
print("Parsed object offsets:", offsets)

# ---------- 2. Decode original content stream (obj 8) ----------
def extract_stream(obj_num):
    off = offsets[obj_num]
    end = src.find(b"endobj", off)
    body = src[off:end]
    lm = re.search(rb"/Length\s+(\d+)", body)
    if not lm:
        raise ValueError(f"obj {obj_num}: no /Length")
    length = int(lm.group(1))
    sm = re.search(rb"stream\r?\n", body)
    if not sm:
        raise ValueError(f"obj {obj_num}: no stream")
    data = body[sm.end():sm.end() + length]
    return body, data

_, raw8 = extract_stream(8)
try:
    decoded8 = zlib.decompress(base64.a85decode(raw8, adobe=False))
except Exception:
    decoded8 = zlib.decompress(base64.a85decode(raw8, adobe=True))
print("--- Original report page content (decoded) ---")
print(decoded8.decode("latin-1"))

# ---------- 3. Build new objects ----------
# Objects 1..6 copied verbatim (same numbers => no reference rewriting needed)
obj_slices = []
for num in (1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6):
    start = offsets[num]
    end = offsets[num + 1]
    obj_slices.append(src[start:end])

# Object 7: Pages root -- now two kids: cover page (9) + original page (4)
obj7 = b"7 0 obj\n<<\n/Count 2 /Kids [ 9 0 R 4 0 R ] /Type /Pages\n>>\nendobj\n"

# Object 8: original content stream re-encoded as plain FlateDecode
compressed8 = zlib.compress(decoded8, 9)
obj8 = (b"8 0 obj\n<< /Filter /FlateDecode /Length %d >>\nstream\n"
        % len(compressed8)) + compressed8 + b"\nendstream\nendobj\n"

# Object 10: cover page content stream (uncompressed; Helvetica-Bold)
today_str = date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")
print("Current date used:", today_str)


def center_x(text, font_size, factor=0.55):
    return (612.0 - factor * font_size * len(text)) / 2.0


title_x = center_x(TITLE, 28, 0.55)
date_x = center_x(today_str, 16, 0.5)
cover_stream = (
    f"BT\n/F1 28 Tf\n{title_x:.2f} 560.00 Td\n({TITLE}) Tj\nET\n"
    f"BT\n/F1 16 Tf\n{date_x:.2f} 505.00 Td\n({today_str}) Tj\nET\n"
).encode("latin-1")
obj10 = (b"10 0 obj\n<< /Length %d >>\nstream\n" % len(cover_stream)
         + cover_stream + b"\nendstream\nendobj\n")

# Object 9: cover page (inline font resource, references stream 10)
obj9 = (b"9 0 obj\n<<\n/Type /Page\n/Parent 7 0 R\n/MediaBox [ 0 0 612 792 ]\n"
        b"/Resources <<\n/Font << /F1 << /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 "
        b"/BaseFont /Helvetica-Bold >> >>\n>>\n/Contents 10 0 R\n>>\nendobj\n")

# ---------- 4. Assemble output PDF ----------
out = bytearray(b"%PDF-1.3\n%\xe2\xe3\xcf\xd3\n")
obj_offsets = []


def write_obj(data):
    obj_offsets.append(len(out))
    out += data


for s in obj_slices:
    write_obj(s)
write_obj(obj7)
write_obj(obj8)
write_obj(obj9)
write_obj(obj10)

# Trailer: preserve /Info and /ID from the original, recompute /Size
idm = re.search(rb"/ID\s*\[\s*(<[0-9a-fA-F]+>)\s*(<[0-9a-fA-F]+>)\s*\]", trailer_text)
id_part = (b"/ID [ " + idm.group(1) + b" " + idm.group(2) + b" ]") if idm else b""

xref_off = len(out)
out += b"xref\n0 11\n0000000000 65535 f \n"
for off in obj_offsets:
    out += b"%010d 00000 n \n" % off
out += (b"trailer\n<< /Size 11 /Root 5 0 R /Info 6 0 R " + id_part + b" >>\n"
        b"startxref\n%d\n%%%%EOF\n" % xref_off)

with open(OUT, "wb") as f:
    f.write(out)
# Also update report.pdf itself so the requested file contains the cover
with open(SRC, "wb") as f:
    f.write(out)
print(f"Wrote merged PDF to {OUT} ({len(out)} bytes) and updated {SRC}")

# ---------- 5. Validation: re-parse the output ----------
data = bytes(out)
vm = re.search(rb"startxref\s+(\d+)", data)
vlines = data[int(vm.group(1)):].split(b"\n")
assert vlines[0] == b"xref"
vcount = int(vlines[1].split()[1])
assert vcount == 11, f"expected 11 xref entries, got {vcount}"
voffs = []
for k in range(1, 11):
    entry = vlines[2 + k].split()
    voffs.append(int(entry[0]))
    assert data[voffs[-1]:voffs[-1] + len(b"%d 0 obj" % k)] == b"%d 0 obj" % k, \
        f"xref entry {k} points to wrong offset"
print("xref validation passed (11 entries, offsets consistent)")

# Check pages tree
assert b"/Count 2 /Kids [ 9 0 R 4 0 R ]" in data, "pages tree not updated"
assert b"/Root 5 0 R" in data, "catalog root missing"

# Decode cover stream (obj 10) and original stream (obj 8) from the output
for num, expected in ((10, [TITLE.encode(), today_str.encode()]),
                      (8, [decoded8])):
    off = voffs[num - 1]
    end = data.find(b"endobj", off)
    body = data[off:end]
    lm = re.search(rb"/Length\s+(\d+)", body)
    sm = re.search(rb"stream\r?\n", body)
    payload = body[sm.end():sm.end() + int(lm.group(1))]
    if b"FlateDecode" in body:
        payload = zlib.decompress(payload)
    text = payload.decode("latin-1")
    print(f"--- Object {num} text ---")
    print(text)
    for exp in expected:
        assert exp in payload, f"missing content in obj {num}: {exp!r}"
print("VALIDATION PASSED: cover title + date on page 1, original content preserved, pages tree = 2 pages.")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Add a cover page (title + current date) to report.pdf using the pdf skill toolkit."""
import os
import sys
from datetime import date

from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter
from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas
from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter

# 1. Locate report.pdf in the workspace
candidates = []
for root, dirs, files in os.walk("."):
    for f in files:
        if f.lower() == "report.pdf":
            candidates.append(os.path.join(root, f))

if not candidates:
    print("ERROR: report.pdf not found in workspace")
    sys.exit(1)

# Prefer the shallowest path (workspace root) if multiple exist
input_path = sorted(candidates, key=lambda p: p.count(os.sep))[0]
print(f"Found report.pdf at: {input_path}")

# 2. Create the cover page PDF
cover_path = "cover_page.pdf"
c = canvas.Canvas(cover_path, pagesize=letter)
width, height = letter

# Title
c.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 28)
c.drawCentredString(width / 2, height - 220, "Annual Financial Report")

# Current date
today = date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")
c.setFont("Helvetica", 16)
c.drawCentredString(width / 2, height - 280, today)

c.save()
print(f"Created cover page: {cover_path} (date: {today})")

# 3. Merge cover page + original report
reader = PdfReader(input_path)
writer = PdfWriter()
cover = PdfReader(cover_path)
writer.add_page(cover.pages[0])
for page in reader.pages:
    writer.add_page(page)

output_path = "report_with_cover.pdf"
with open(output_path, "wb") as f:
    writer.write(f)

print(f"Created merged file: {output_path}")
print(f"Total pages: {len(writer.pages)} (1 cover + {len(reader.pages)} report)")

# 4. Validate: extract text from the first page of the output
check = PdfReader(output_path)
first_text = check.pages[0].extract_text() or ""
assert "Annual Financial Report" in first_text, "Cover title missing!"
assert today in first_text, "Cover date missing!"
print("Validation passed: cover title and date present on page 1.")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Add a cover page (title + current date) to report.pdf using pypdf only."""
import os
import sys
from datetime import date

from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter
from pypdf.generic import (
    DecodedStreamObject,
    DictionaryObject,
    NameObject,
)

# 1. Locate report.pdf in the workspace
candidates = []
for root, dirs, files in os.walk("."):
    for f in files:
        if f.lower() == "report.pdf":
            candidates.append(os.path.join(root, f))

if not candidates:
    print("ERROR: report.pdf not found in workspace")
    sys.exit(1)

input_path = sorted(candidates, key=lambda p: p.count(os.sep))[0]
print(f"Found report.pdf at: {input_path}")

PAGE_W, PAGE_H = 612.0, 792.0  # US Letter


def make_cover_page(title, date_str, cover_path):
    writer = PdfWriter()
    page = writer.add_blank_page(width=PAGE_W, height=PAGE_H)

    # Standard 14 font resource (Helvetica-Bold)
    font = DictionaryObject({
        NameObject("/Type"): NameObject("/Font"),
        NameObject("/Subtype"): NameObject("/Type1"),
        NameObject("/BaseFont"): NameObject("/Helvetica-Bold"),
    })
    resources = DictionaryObject({
        NameObject("/Font"): DictionaryObject({NameObject("/F1"): font}),
    })

    def center_x(text, font_size):
        # Approximate Helvetica-Bold average advance ~0.55 * font size
        width = len(text) * 0.55 * font_size
        return (PAGE_W - width) / 2.0

    title_x = center_x(title, 28)
    date_x = center_x(date_str, 16)

    content = DecodedStreamObject()
    content.set_data(
        (
            "BT\n"
            "/F1 28 Tf\n"
            f"{title_x:.2f} {PAGE_H - 220:.2f} Td\n"
            f"({title}) Tj\n"
            "ET\n"
            "BT\n"
            "/F1 16 Tf\n"
            f"{date_x:.2f} {PAGE_H - 280:.2f} Td\n"
            f"({date_str}) Tj\n"
            "ET\n"
        ).encode("latin-1")
    )

    page[NameObject("/Contents")] = content
    page[NameObject("/Resources")] = resources

    with open(cover_path, "wb") as f:
        writer.write(f)


today = date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")
cover_path = "cover_page.pdf"
make_cover_page("Annual Financial Report", today, cover_path)
print(f"Created cover page: {cover_path} (date: {today})")

# 2. Merge cover page + original report
reader = PdfReader(input_path)
writer = PdfWriter()
cover = PdfReader(cover_path)
writer.add_page(cover.pages[0])
for page in reader.pages:
    writer.add_page(page)

output_path = "report_with_cover.pdf"
with open(output_path, "wb") as f:
    writer.write(f)

print(f"Created merged file: {output_path}")
print(f"Total pages: {len(writer.pages)} (1 cover + {len(reader.pages)} report)")

# 3. Validate: extract text from the first page of the output
check = PdfReader(output_path)
first_text = check.pages[0].extract_text() or ""
print("--- Page 1 text ---")
print(first_text)
assert "Annual Financial Report" in first_text, "Cover title missing!"
assert today in first_text, "Cover date missing!"
print("Validation passed: cover title and date present on page 1.")

"""Inspect report.pdf structure and look for usable PDF libraries on disk."""
import os
import re
import site
import sys

# 1. Locate report.pdf
candidates = []

    dirs[:] = [d for d in dirs if d not in (".git", "node_modules", "__pycache__")]
    for f in files:
        if f.lower() == "report.pdf":
            candidates.append(os.path.join(root, f))

    sys.exit(1)

path = sorted(candidates, key=lambda p: p.count(os.sep))[0]
print(f"Using: {path} ({os.path.getsize(path)} bytes)")

with open(path, "rb") as f:
    data = f.read()

print("Header:", data[:16])
print("Has '%PDF':", data.startswith(b"%PDF"))

m = re.search(rb"startxref\s+(\d+)", data)
if m:
    sx = int(m.group(1))
    print("startxref offset:", sx)

    print("xref section head:", snippet[:120])
    print("xref is stream:", b"/Type" in snippet and b"XRef" in snippet)
else:

print("occurrences of '/ObjStm':", data.count(b"/ObjStm"))
filters = set(re.findall(rb"/Filter\s*/(\w+)", data))
print("filters seen:", filters)
print("has FlateDecode:", b"FlateDecode" in data)
print("has ASCIIHex/85:", b"ASCIIHexDecode" in data or b"ASCII85Decode" in data)

# 2. Where could pypdf/PIL live? Check interpreter site-packages + likely venvs.
print("--- interpreter paths ---")
print("sys.path:", sys.path)
try:
    print("site.getsitepackages():", site.getsitepackages())
except Exception as e:
    print("getsitepackages error:", e)

print("--- searching disk for pypdf/PIL modules (bounded) ---")
search_roots = [".codex", "/usr/lib", "/usr/local/lib", "/opt"]
found = []
for base in search_roots:
    if not os.path.isdir(base):
        continue
    for root, dirs, files in os.walk(base):
        dirs[:] = [d for d in dirs if d not in ("__pycache__", "node_modules")]
        # bound the walk
        for f in files:
            low = f.lower()
            if low in ("pypdf", "pil", "pdfplumber", "pypdfium2", "fitz", "reportlab") or low.startswith("pypdf"):
                found.append(os.path.join(root, f))
        if len(found) >= 30:
            break
    if len(found) >= 30:
        break
print(f"candidate module paths (showing up to 30):")
for p in found[:30]:
    print(" ", p)
if not found:
    print("  none found")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Add a cover page ('Annual Financial Report' + current date) to report.pdf.

Pure Python + stdlib (base64, zlib, re). report.pdf is PDF-1.3 with a classic
xref and no object streams, so objects can be copied verbatim and only the
Pages tree, the content stream, and the trailer need rebuilding.
"""
import base64
import re
import sys
import zlib
from datetime import date

SRC = "report.pdf"
OUT = "report_with_cover.pdf"
TITLE = "Annual Financial Report"

with open(SRC, "rb") as f:
    src = f.read()

# ---------- 1. Parse classic xref ----------
m = re.search(rb"startxref\s+(\d+)", src)
if not m:
    print("ERROR: no startxref")
    sys.exit(1)
lines = src[int(m.group(1)):].split(b"\n")
offsets = {}
i = 0
trailer_text = b""
while i < len(lines):
    line = lines[i].strip()
    if line == b"xref":
        i += 1
        continue
    if line == b"trailer":
        trailer_text = b" ".join(lines[i + 1:])
        break
    parts = line.split()
    if len(parts) == 2 and parts[0].isdigit():
        start, count = int(parts[0]), int(parts[1])
        for k in range(count):
            e = lines[i + 1 + k].split()
            if len(e) == 3 and e[2] == b"n":
                offsets[start + k] = int(e[0])
        i += 1 + count
    else:
        i += 1
print("Parsed object offsets:", offsets)

# ---------- 2. Decode original content stream (obj 8) ----------
def extract_stream(obj_num):
    off = offsets[obj_num]
    end = src.find(b"endobj", off)
    body = src[off:end]
    lm = re.search(rb"/Length\s+(\d+)", body)
    if not lm:
        raise ValueError(f"obj {obj_num}: no /Length")
    length = int(lm.group(1))
    sm = re.search(rb"stream\r?\n", body)
    if not sm:
        raise ValueError(f"obj {obj_num}: no stream")
    data = body[sm.end():sm.end() + length]
    return body, data

_, raw8 = extract_stream(8)
try:
    decoded8 = zlib.decompress(base64.a85decode(raw8, adobe=False))
except Exception:
    decoded8 = zlib.decompress(base64.a85decode(raw8, adobe=True))
print("--- Original report page content (decoded) ---")
print(decoded8.decode("latin-1"))

# ---------- 3. Build new objects ----------
# Objects 1..6 copied verbatim (same numbers => no reference rewriting needed)
obj_slices = []
for num in (1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6):
    start = offsets[num]
    end = offsets[num + 1]
    obj_slices.append(src[start:end])

# Object 7: Pages root -- now two kids: cover page (9) + original page (4)
obj7 = b"7 0 obj\n<<\n/Count 2 /Kids [ 9 0 R 4 0 R ] /Type /Pages\n>>\nendobj\n"

# Object 8: original content stream re-encoded as plain FlateDecode
compressed8 = zlib.compress(decoded8, 9)
obj8 = (b"8 0 obj\n<< /Filter /FlateDecode /Length %d >>\nstream\n"
        % len(compressed8)) + compressed8 + b"\nendstream\nendobj\n"

# Object 10: cover page content stream (uncompressed; Helvetica-Bold)
today_str = date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")
print("Current date used:", today_str)


def center_x(text, font_size, factor=0.55):
    return (612.0 - factor * font_size * len(text)) / 2.0


title_x = center_x(TITLE, 28, 0.55)
date_x = center_x(today_str, 16, 0.5)
cover_stream = (
    f"BT\n/F1 28 Tf\n{title_x:.2f} 560.00 Td\n({TITLE}) Tj\nET\n"
    f"BT\n/F1 16 Tf\n{date_x:.2f} 505.00 Td\n({today_str}) Tj\nET\n"
).encode("latin-1")
obj10 = (b"10 0 obj\n<< /Length %d >>\nstream\n" % len(cover_stream)
         + cover_stream + b"\nendstream\nendobj\n")

# Object 9: cover page (inline font resource, references stream 10)
obj9 = (b"9 0 obj\n<<\n/Type /Page\n/Parent 7 0 R\n/MediaBox [ 0 0 612 792 ]\n"
        b"/Resources <<\n/Font << /F1 << /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 "
        b"/BaseFont /Helvetica-Bold >> >>\n>>\n/Contents 10 0 R\n>>\nendobj\n")

# ---------- 4. Assemble output PDF ----------
out = bytearray(b"%PDF-1.3\n%\xe2\xe3\xcf\xd3\n")
obj_offsets = []


def write_obj(data):
    obj_offsets.append(len(out))
    out += data


for s in obj_slices:
    write_obj(s)
write_obj(obj7)
write_obj(obj8)
write_obj(obj9)
write_obj(obj10)

# Trailer: preserve /Info and /ID from the original, recompute /Size
idm = re.search(rb"/ID\s*\[\s*(<[0-9a-fA-F]+>)\s*(<[0-9a-fA-F]+>)\s*\]", trailer_text)
id_part = (b"/ID [ " + idm.group(1) + b" " + idm.group(2) + b" ]") if idm else b""

xref_off = len(out)
out += b"xref\n0 11\n0000000000 65535 f \n"
for off in obj_offsets:
    out += b"%010d 00000 n \n" % off
out += (b"trailer\n<< /Size 11 /Root 5 0 R /Info 6 0 R " + id_part + b" >>\n"
        b"startxref\n%d\n%%%%EOF\n" % xref_off)

with open(OUT, "wb") as f:
    f.write(out)
# Also update report.pdf itself so the requested file contains the cover
with open(SRC, "wb") as f:
    f.write(out)
print(f"Wrote merged PDF to {OUT} ({len(out)} bytes) and updated {SRC}")

# ---------- 5. Validation: re-parse the output ----------
data = bytes(out)
vm = re.search(rb"startxref\s+(\d+)", data)
vlines = data[int(vm.group(1)):].split(b"\n")
assert vlines[0] == b"xref"
vcount = int(vlines[1].split()[1])
assert vcount == 11, f"expected 11 xref entries, got {vcount}"
voffs = []
for k in range(1, 11):
    entry = vlines[2 + k].split()
    voffs.append(int(entry[0]))
    assert data[voffs[-1]:voffs[-1] + len(b"%d 0 obj" % k)] == b"%d 0 obj" % k, \
        f"xref entry {k} points to wrong offset"
print("xref validation passed (11 entries, offsets consistent)")

# Check pages tree
assert b"/Count 2 /Kids [ 9 0 R 4 0 R ]" in data, "pages tree not updated"
assert b"/Root 5 0 R" in data, "catalog root missing"

# Decode cover stream (obj 10) and original stream (obj 8) from the output
for num, expected in ((10, [TITLE.encode(), today_str.encode()]),
                      (8, [decoded8])):
    off = voffs[num - 1]
    end = data.find(b"endobj", off)
    body = data[off:end]
    lm = re.search(rb"/Length\s+(\d+)", body)
    sm = re.search(rb"stream\r?\n", body)
    payload = body[sm.end():sm.end() + int(lm.group(1))]
    if b"FlateDecode" in body:
        payload = zlib.decompress(payload)
    text = payload.decode("latin-1")
    print(f"--- Object {num} text ---")
    print(text)
    for exp in expected:
        assert exp in payload, f"missing content in obj {num}: {exp!r}"
print("VALIDATION PASSED: cover title + date on page 1, original content preserved, pages tree = 2 pages.")
